～Chapter 6～
The Blazing Tower

Is everybody here?
Then let’s begin.
According to <NAME>’s investigation, the Regalia were nowhere to be found in Yamato.
If they weren’t lying around Yamato, then that can only mean...
They must be within the Sacred Demon Castle.
That’s right. The Regalia are likely to be in the Sacred Demon Castle.
Yokihiko, how are you holding up?

Oh, I’m fine.
The Regalia are more important anyhow.
Kaede, the Pandemonium Regalia are in the Sacred Demon Castle.
I checked every nook and cranny of Yamato, too, but no Regalia!
Then I was about to go pay the castle a visit myself, but then I went and got captured...
The Sacred Demon Castle is just up ahead, right?
That’s correct.

Then it’s settled.
Next stop, Sacred Demon Castle.
The other two Regalia must be there.
Kaede, what is this “Sacred Demon Castle”?
It’s the castle that sunk into the ocean along with Yamato.
It’s a cursed castle, lorded over by all manner of vengeful spirits.
The enemy grows stronger...
Indeed...
<NAME>, steel yourself for the trials ahead.
Yes, ma’am!

Yes, ma’am!
Roger that!
Oh! Good answer!

Please do your best, !
If at first you don’t succeed, try it again!
<NAME>, this is not a good time to be spacing out.
You need to pull yourself together.
R-Right.
<NAME>, you are hereby ordered to investigate the Sacred Demon Castle.

Good luck! ♥
Mwah! ♥
